title: The story shows bitter love but a chaste life
english: The story of Clitophon displays bitter love, but a chaste life. Leucippe's most chaste life amazes everyone: beaten, shorn, abused, and—greatest of all—having died three times, Leucippe endured. If you too wish to live chastely, my friend, do not dwell on the incidental spectacle of the writing, but learn first the movement of the story. For it escorts those who love wisely to the bridal chamber.
